reason: I buy outfits before Ramadan, Eid and weddings, and in November I have nothing coming up, so I'd maybe stop in to look and wouldn't buy anything. I'd come back closer to Ramadan if what I saw was actually special.
objection: Embroidered thobes and plain $45 abayas sound like what I already see on Hillcroft and in my closet. I want something new and a bit elevated each season, not the same Gulf-style pieces every shop carries.
would_change_my_mind: A wedding or henna invite in the next few weeks, plus seeing a statement piece in the store that I can't find at the Hillcroft shops.
